As is known to all, in half-pipe games, the shape of the half-pipe has some influences on the
performances of the snowboarders in many aspects, such as the “vertical air” and the average
degree of rotation. It’s a big challenge for the snowboard designers to determine the shape of the
half-pipe so as to achieve the desired performances. This problem can be attributed to an
For Question One, an interesting optimization model is constructed for the “vertical air”
based on the theory of Dynamics. In particular, in order to achieve the maximum vertical distance
above the edge of the half-pipe, we have derived the best height of the platform, which is 6.241
meters. On the other hand, by the relationship between the arc angle of the transitions and the
vertical component of velocity, the best value for the arc angle of the transitions is determined to
be 51.66°. Furthermore, according to the analytic expression of the curve of velocity recovery,
we calculate the width of the flat is 19.18 meters. Finally, by the four steps method, the length of

spans.text: the U-shape bowl is calculated as 159.95 meters.
